-- Compiled proof, equivalent to #print DY.Example.SignedDH.client_secrecy
theorem DY.Example.SignedDH.client_secrecy :
∀ {time : Nat} (client server : DY.Participant) (xPk yPk k : DY.Bytes) (tr : DY.ExecTrace),
  DY.Trace.Reachable DY.Example.SignedDH.reachability tr →
    k.AttackerKnows tr →
      DY.Trace.EventLoggedAt (DY.Example.SignedDH.SignedDHEvent.ClientFinishEvent client server xPk yPk k) time tr →
        have tr_before := DY.Trace.prefix tr time;
        (∃ spk, DY.LongTermKeys.LongTermKeyCompromised "SignedDH PKI" server spk tr_before) ∨
          DY.Example.SignedDH.ClientEphemeralStateCompromised client xPk tr ∨
            DY.Example.SignedDH.ServerEphemeralStateCompromised server yPk tr
:=
fun {time} client server xPk yPk k =>
  DY.Trace.apply_Reachable_implies_Invariant fun tr h_trinv h_pub h_ev =>
    have this :=
      DY.Trace.EventLoggedAt_imp_EventInv (DY.Example.SignedDH.SignedDHEvent.ClientFinishEvent client server xPk yPk k)
        time tr h_trinv h_ev;
    id
      (DY.Example.SignedDH.client_secrecy._proof_1_5✝ client server xPk yPk k tr h_trinv h_pub
        (id
          (Eq.mp
            (congr
              (congrArg Or
                (congrFun'
                  (congrArg And
                    (congrArg
                      (DY.Trace.EventLogged (DY.Example.SignedDH.SignedDHEvent.ServerFinishEvent server xPk yPk k))
                      (DY.Trace.prefix_erase tr time)))
                  (k.Invariant (DY.Trace.prefix tr time) ∧
                    k.label (DY.Trace.prefix tr time) =
                      (DY.Example.SignedDH.clientLabel client xPk).join (DY.Example.SignedDH.serverLabel server yPk))))
              (congrArg Exists
                (funext fun spk =>
                  congrArg (DY.LongTermKeys.label "SignedDH PKI" server spk).isCorrupt
                    (DY.Trace.prefix_erase tr time))))
            this)))
